pages.text: Use a Secondment Collar on a host, with hands. Then Use a jarred head on it: the jar twists on and the head drives the body. It is staff now, on its own file, and looks for a Time Clock of yours.

$(l)The head is skills$(): its jobs and how fast, its wage, its turret post (an attacking head shoots from the jar), its temper.$(br2)$(l)The body is hardware$(): how it moves, hands, carry, health, and its tricks.

$(l)Team Sync$()$(br)1%% every 24 s of work, on shift with a card; half when the blood does not mix (an oil body takes any head).$(br)25%%: the body's traits$(br)50%%: its Ability; the lace takes$(br)75%%: its Secondary$(br)100%%: 10%% faster, carries 10%% more
pages.title: Form 13-S

pages.text: The collar's canister holds 500 mB: a mB every 6 seconds, about 50 minutes. It tops up at each punch-in from the clock's Broth tank. Dry, the head sags and the body stands by.$(br2)The body still rots. A mixed team needs Embalming Fluid before the lace.

When the body dies the collar fires the $(l)Redundancy Package$(): the head floats down under a little gold canopy and lands as a placed head, file and grade kept.$(br2)It is lost only if its glass was gone, it fell into the void, or it came down in lava.

Sneak and Use with an empty hand: the head comes off into your hand. Shears take an empty collar back. A Glass Patch mends the jar, a bucket of broth fills the canister, a syringe held sneaking draws the head.$(br2)$(o)A body with no mind meets a mind with no body. HR calls it synergy.$()
